modelDescription: Major Kinetic Energy.  The first all-steel  shotshell from HEVI-Shot is pushed out  at a blistering 1500 fps, compared to competing fast steel loads, which run at 1450fps  (12g 3” 1.25oz).  This increase in speed delivers 9% more energy at 30 yards and 8% at 40!  In short, you will get more knockdown power and fewer crippled birds.  Combining higher velocity, a best-in-class wad and precision manufacturing techniques delivers the ultimate in performance. HEVI-Steel hits hard every time!
